description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing user session actions such as login, post-login processing, and logout. It includes methods for handling HTTP GET, POST, and HEAD requests, managing session state, cookies, and redirection logic.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Session
classes.description: Controller class handling user session management including login, logout, and session validation.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles GET, HEAD requests for the login page, checks if user is already logged in, and prepares login form data.

methods.name: post_login
methods.description: Processes login form submission, authenticates user, sets session and cookies, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, clears session data, and redirects to a logged-out confirmation.
